name: count-up-digits
title: Count Up Digits
description: A free React count-up animation that rolls its digits like an odometer. Every column runs on its own spring, so digits far from their target spin fast and settle with a small overshoot. It starts when scrolled into view, counts again when pressed, and keeps the final number in the page text for screen readers.
